cues: A slow lag phase, while cells get ready.
A log phase, when growth is exponential.
A deceleration phase, as space and resources run short.
And a stationary phase, at maturity.
text: It has four phases. A slow lag phase, while cells get ready. A log phase, when growth is exponential. A deceleration phase, as space and resources run short. And a stationary phase, at maturity.
